newsitem.title: USA: USDA seeks comment on WORC meat packer petition.
newsitem.headline: USDA seeks comment on WORC meat packer petition.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Monday said it was seeking comment on a petition for rulemaking from the Western Organization of Resource Councils (WORC) that USDA restrict some meat packer practices.
The petition asks USDA to initiate a rulemaking to bar packers from getting cattle for slaughter through use of a forward contract unless certain specified conditions are met.
It also seeks to prohibit packers from owning and feeding cattle unless the animals are sold for slaughter in "an open, public market."

"USDA understands the concerns that gave rise to this petition," Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said in a statement. "To evaluate fully the petition, we are encouraging all interested parties to comment on the important issues it raises."
USDA will publish a notice in Federal Register Jan. 14.
The department said the group, which sent the petition in October, believes the practices have decreased prices paid to cattle producers and unjustly discriminate against some producers.
